convert_segformer_checkpoint: convert a SegFormer original PyTorch checkpoint to HuggingFace PyTorch model format for semantic segmentation or image classification
rename_keys_state_dict: rename keys in a SegFormer state dict to match HuggingFace transformers model naming conventions
read_in_k_v_state_dict: split combined key-value weights into separate key and value matrices in a SegFormer state dict
prepare_img: download and prepare a COCO validation image for SegFormer model conversion verification
convert_segformer_cli: run SegFormer checkpoint conversion from command line with model name, checkpoint path, and output folder arguments
